name: Token ID shown beside a pairing token
description: JFrog's access tokens page says the window shown when a pairing token is generated includes the token's expiration, the token ID and the actual token, so the token ID is displayed beside the token as a separate item. The page does not say whether the token ID may be disclosed and states no format for it, so its benign status is a lead and no sample value is recorded.

sources.supports: This displays the token window, which includes the token's expiration (in seconds, set by default to 300 seconds = 5 minutes), the token ID, and the actual token, which you can copy by clicking Copy.
sources.locator: Pairing Tokens to Bind a JPD and a Mission Control Microservice
